theater: 卡累利阿地峽與維堡灣

battle.name: 繼續戰爭
battle.theater: 卡累利阿地峽與維堡灣
battle.brief: 1941年6月25日，芬蘭在曼納海姆元帥指揮下於卡累利阿地峽同時發動攻勢，兩個月收復維堡與東卡累利阿，把戰線推至斯維里河；1944年蘇聯集中火炮與航空兵力突破地峽防線，芬軍退回1940年舊界，9月19日在莫斯科停戰。卡面鐵甲艦本身不在卡累利阿林海，但蘇聯波羅的海艦隊殘存主力艦「馬拉特」在維堡灣遭芬蘭岸炮重創，仍是鐵甲裝甲與重炮對決的餘響。

kit.name: 鐵甲艦
kit.history: 木殼外面包了鐵。裝甲第一次比砲更難對付，砲塔的設計從此繞著它轉。

countries: 1941年6月25日至1944年9月19日，交戰方是芬蘭與蘇聯，戰場集中在東卡累利阿、北芬蘭、摩爾曼斯克方向與維堡灣。芬蘭是德國的共同交戰國，但並非軸心國的正式成員；蘇聯則是同盟國一方的核心。芬蘭方面，曼納海姆元帥自1941年3月起任國防委員會主席兼武裝部隊總司令，參謀總部設在米凱利地下總部，戰線編為卡累利阿地峽軍（曼納海姆直接指揮）、拉多加卡累利阿集團軍（塔爾維拉）與北方集團軍（西拉斯沃，其後由帕亞里接掌）。地峽方面由第四軍、第十軍等軍級單位率第三、第四、十一、十八師與多個旅作戰，1944年春夏再新組第一（拉普蘭）、第四（拉普蘭）、第九、第十五師等十餘個新師。蘇聯方面由最高統帥部統籌，1941年以穆爾曼斯克方面軍、列寧格勒方面軍與卡累利阿方面軍，投入第十四、第十九、第二十三、第二十五、第三十二軍；1944年的維堡—彼得羅扎沃茨克攻勢則由列寧格勒方面軍的戈沃羅夫與卡累利阿方面軍的梅列茨科夫指揮。德軍北方集團軍群只在北卡累利阿與突擊集團軍方面同芬軍協同，芬軍自1941年秋天起逐步收回戰線主導權。
countriesEn: Fighting ran from 25 June 1941 to 19 September 1944 between Finland and the Soviet Union, in East Karelia, northern Finland, the Murmansk direction and the Gulf of Finland around Vyborg. Finland entered the war as a co-belligerent of Germany rather than a formal member of the Axis, while the Soviet Union stood at the core of the Allied side. On the Finnish side, Field Marshal Carl Gustaf Emil Mannerheim became Chairman of the Defence Council and Commander-in-Chief of the armed forces in March 1941, with the General Staff in the underground command post at Mikkeli. The front was organised into the Army of the Isthmus under Mannerheim himself, the Ladoga Karelia Group under Paavo Talvela, and the North Finland Group under Hjalmar Siilasvuo, later taken over by Olavi Pajari. On the Karelian Isthmus the IV and X Corps, with the 3rd, 4th, 11th and 18th Divisions and several brigades, did the main work, and in the spring and summer of 1944 the Finns raised more than ten new divisions, among them the 1st and 4th Lapland Divisions, the 9th and the 15th. The Soviet side was run by the Stavka: the Murmansk, Leningrad and Karelian Fronts committed the 14th, 19th, 23rd, 25th and 32nd Armies in 1941, while the Vyborg-Petrozavodsk offensive of 1944 was directed by Leonid Govorov of the Leningrad Front and Karl Meretskov of the Karelian Front. German Army Group North operated alongside the Finns in North Karelia and around the Petsamo-Kirkenes sector, but from the autumn of 1941 the Finnish command progressively took back control of its own front.
people: 決定戰局的是芬蘭元帥卡爾・古斯塔夫・埃米爾・曼納海姆：他自1941年3月出任總司令，並在同年3月9日以《曼納海姆指示》為全軍定下作戰基調——速度、連續作戰、於決定地段集中優勢兵力、避免正面強攻、預備隊只留給決定性會戰，偵察則大量交給偵察分隊與空軍。他親臨前線指揮1941年夏季的地峽攻勢與冬季向斯維里河的推進。1944年蘇聯總攻之後，是他拍板接受停戰，並於同年8月出任芬蘭總統，1946年3月辭職。總統里斯托是主張對德親善、促成對蘇開戰的人；派亞西基維則早在1942年就判斷德軍不可能取勝，並在1943至44年間悄悄改變政策，成為停戰的重要推手。希特勒於1942年6月4日到訪芬蘭，是這位德國領袖唯一一次踏足前線戰區。蘇聯方面，斯大林在1941年7月自任國防人民委員長並向芬蘭方向調兵；朱可夫曾提出深入卡累利阿地峽的藍山方案而未獲採納；戈沃羅夫與梅列茨科夫主導1944年夏季的攻勢。芬軍一線由塔爾維拉、西拉斯沃、奧伊諾寧、瓦爾維等師長與軍長率領。1944年8月伊爾馬里寧號與凱伊哈薩爾米號上的反共軍官密謀駛往瑞典，是戰爭後期芬蘭內部政治裂痕的露頭。
peopleEn: The decisive figure was Field Marshal Carl Gustaf Emil Mannerheim. He took command in March 1941 and on 9 March set down the doctrine for the whole army in the Mannerheim Instructions: speed, continuous operations, concentration of superior strength at the decisive point, no frontal assault, reserves held back for the decisive battle, and reconnaissance pushed onto patrols and the air force. He personally directed the offensive on the Karelian Isthmus in the summer of 1941 and the drive to the Svir in the winter. After the Soviet general offensive of 1944 he decided to accept the peace terms, was raised to president of Finland in August of that year, and resigned in March 1946. President Risto Ryti, who pressed for a pro-German line and for war with the Soviet Union, and Juho Kusti Paasikivi, who had concluded as early as 1942 that Germany would lose the war and who quietly reversed course in 1943-44, were the two other poles of Finnish policy. Adolf Hitler visited Finland on 4 June 1942, the only time the German leader went to a combat front. On the Soviet side Stalin took over as People's Commissar for Defence in July 1941 and shifted reserves towards the Finnish front; Zhukov drafted a deep plan of penetration for the Karelian Isthmus that was never approved; Govorov and Meretskov directed the offensives of the summer of 1944. Corps and army commanders such as Talvela, Siilasvuo, Oinonen and Väinö Valve led the fighting in the line, and the conspiracy of anti-communist naval officers aboard Ilmarinen and Keihässalmi in August 1944, who planned to sail for Sweden, showed how deeply the war was entangled with Finnish domestic politics.
kits: 卡面鐵甲艦係1862年英國那種以鐵帶包住木殼的裝甲戰艦，本質係用裝甲換取喺舊式木殼砲火之下嘅生存力；繼續戰爭本身冇1862年嘅戰列艦參戰，但呢條裝甲血脈貫穿全場。蘇聯波羅的海艦隊殘存嘅兩艘裝甲主力艦馬拉特號與十月革命號正係前無畏艦時代嘅鐵甲裝甲軍艦，1941年9月19日馬拉特號在維堡灣被芬蘭索穆薩里島岸炮（152毫米與234毫米口徑）命中兩發，裝甲帶被打穿——正正係鐵甲時代砲能不能穿甲的老問題。芬蘭海軍只有兩艘裝甲海岸防護艦（伊爾馬里寧號、芙魯瑪利亞號）、兩艘佈雷艦、四艘魚雷艇、十七艘高速魚雷艇、十九艘潛水艇與五十七艘機動機，伊爾馬里寧號更在1941年9月25日被蘇聯潛艇擊沉。陸軍方面有蘇米 KP/-31 與 KP/-34 衝鋒槍、毛瑟 M/31 步槍與 M/38 卡賓槍、馬克西姆 M/32 輕機槍、37毫米博福斯反裝甲砲、47毫米反裝甲砲、76毫米連隊砲、105與122毫米榴彈砲、科夫工廠製造嘅135與150毫米重型榴彈砲；裝甲車輛有蘇聯援助嘅 SU-26、SU-33 裝甲車、T-26 與 T-28 輕戰車，1942至43年仿製德國38(t)底盤造出約四十輛 V-33 蘇西戰車，1944年喺斯維里與伊洛曼察作戰。空軍有布魯斯特 BF-109、福克 D.XXI、Ju 87、從加拿大買來嘅32架格洛斯特格鬥士戰鬥機、從英國買來嘅十餘架布萊登漢轟炸機（1941年空襲佩特索莫），另有40毫米與120毫米高射砲。補給線靠維堡港、1941年通車約八十公里、1944年延伸至約三百公里嘅前線鐵路連接維堡與薩拉，1944年英美援助物資部分經白海—波羅的海運河運抵。
kitsEn: The card shows an ironclad in the British sense of 1862, a warship in which a wooden hull was belted with iron, armour bought as a substitute for surviving wooden-hull gunfire. No 1862 battleship fought in the Continuation War, but the armoured lineage runs straight through the campaign. The two armoured capital ships left to the Soviet Baltic Fleet, Marat and Oktyabrskaya Revolutsiya, were pre-dreadnought iron-armoured warships, and on 19 September 1941 Marat was hit twice by the Finnish coastal guns on Suursaari, 152 mm and 234 mm pieces, the belt being pierced: the old ironclad question of whether guns could defeat armour, asked once more. The Finnish Navy fielded only two armoured coastal defence ships, Ilmarinen and Vrouw Maria, two minelayers, four torpedo boats, seventeen motor torpedo boats, nineteen submarines and fifty-seven motor boats, and Ilmarinen was sunk by a Soviet submarine on 25 September 1941. On land the Finns had Suomi KP/-31 and KP/-34 submachine guns, Mauser M/31 rifles and M/38 carbines, Maxim M/32 light machine guns, 37 mm Bofors and 47 mm anti-tank guns, 76 mm regimental guns, 105 and 122 mm howitzers, and heavy 135 and 150 mm Koff howitzers. Armour consisted of Soviet-supplied SU-26 and SU-33 armoured cars, T-26 and T-28 light tanks, and about forty V-33 Susi tanks built in 1942-43 on the German 38(t) chassis, which fought at the Svir and at Ilomantsi in 1944. The Air Force flew Brewster BF-109s, Fokker D.XXIs, Ju 87s, thirty-two Gloster Gladiators bought from Canada and a dozen Bristol Blenheims bought from Britain that raided Petsamo in 1941, backed by 40 mm and 120 mm anti-aircraft guns. Supply ran on Vyborg harbour and on the Frontier Railway, about eighty kilometres in 1941 and some three hundred kilometres by 1944, while in 1944 part of the Anglo-American supplies arrived by the White Sea-Baltic Canal.
tactics: 1941年6月25日拂曉，卡累利阿地峽全線同步發動，四個師集中喺維堡東面嘅索馬洛與薩里拉方向作主要突破，第一日即撕開蘇軍縱深；芬軍刻意避免逐點強攻，改以小分隊夜間滲透、迂回殲滅，奪取路口同橋樑。《曼納海姆指示》要求全軍以速度、連續作戰同局部優勢兵力取勝，預備隊只留給決定性會戰，偵察交由偵察分隊與空軍偵察完成。突破之後，芬軍沿一條約三百公里長的縱深軸線直取東卡累利阿，1941年8月29日進入維堡，同年冬天推進到斯維里河畔，切斷蘇聯白海—波羅的海運河航路。1944年形勢逆轉，芬軍在假設線與 VT 線上轉入純粹防禦：VT 線長約一百一十三公里、最深約六公尺，掘有約六千個地堡與上千個砲位；蘇軍以一次鋪開逾千門火炮的縱深射擊配合航空兵支援，再用步兵沿多個突破口同時楔入，芬軍靠縱深梯隊與反斜面陣地逐次消耗，拖到八月中旬先喺伊洛曼察把蘇軍第三十二軍逐退。海戰方面，芬蘭以佈雷、岸炮伏擊、潛艇襲擊同護航組成的近岸破壞戰術對抗蘇聯波羅的海艦隊：維堡灣與蘇灣佈雷、索穆薩里島岸炮重創馬拉特號、1941年9月23日高速魚雷艇擊沉格涅夫內依號，全部係近海削弱式打法，唔求同主力艦正面決鬥。
tacticsEn: At first light on 25 June 1941 the whole Karelian Isthmus went forward at once, four divisions striking for the breakthroughs east of Vyborg around Sumala and Sairala and tearing the Soviet front open on the first day. The Finns deliberately avoided point-by-point frontal assault, preferring small night penetrations, flank movements and the destruction of road junctions and bridges. The Mannerheim Instructions demanded speed, continuous operations and local superiority, reserves committed only to the decisive battle, with reconnaissance handed to patrols and the air force. After the break-in the advance ran along a single axis some three hundred kilometres deep into East Karelia; Vyborg was entered on 29 August 1941, and in the winter the drive reached the Svir, cutting the White Sea-Baltic Canal route. In 1944 the initiative reversed, and the Finns passed to pure defence on the Hypothesis Line and the VT Line: the latter ran about 113 kilometres, was dug to a depth of some six metres and held roughly six thousand bunkers and a thousand gun positions. The Soviet artillery opened up with more than a thousand guns at once, aircraft support followed, and infantry was pushed in through several breaches simultaneously, while the Finnish defence fought in depth and on reverse slopes, holding until the Soviet 32nd Army was thrown back at Ilomantsi in mid-August. At sea the Finns fought the Baltic Fleet with a close-in doctrine of mined lanes, coastal gun ambush, submarine attack and convoy escort, laying minefields in the Gulf of Finland and the Gulf of Bothnia, wounding Marat from the Suursaari batteries and sinking the destroyer Gnevny with motor torpedo boats on 23 September 1941, all of it a war of attrition at sea rather than a fleet action.
data: 兵力方面，芬蘭1941年動員約五十三萬人，1944年高峰約六十三萬至七十萬人（含輔助與後備），而全國總人口由1941年約四百四十萬降至1944年約三百八十萬。1941年6月地峽方面芬軍投入約二十五萬人、四個師與五個旅，蘇軍第一線約十五個師、第二線約十個師；1944年9月蘇軍喺維堡—彼得羅扎沃茨克方向集結逾千門火炮與上千架飛機。傷亡方面，芬蘭官方與戰後統計多指繼續戰爭與拉普蘭戰爭合計陣亡約五萬三千至六萬三千人、被俘約二千人，至1955年先返國；蘇聯陣亡按蘇方公布約十六萬至十七萬人，芬方與西方研究則評估為八萬至十三萬人；芬軍官方紀念說法指防守 VT 線一役雙方陣亡約五萬人與十四萬人。距離上，1941年自維堡東面到斯維里河的推進軸線約三百公里，維堡距1940年蘇聯邊界僅數十公里。疆土上，芬蘭割讓佩特索莫、薩拉與科薩莫南部及維堡灣諸島，約佔本土面積一成至一成二，約四十萬至四十六萬名卡累利阿居民被疏散；前線鐵路1941年約八十公里、1944年約三百公里；1947年巴黎和約規定賠償三億美元、佩特索莫鎳礦租予蘇聯十五年、波卡拉租作蘇聯海軍基地至1956年。
dataEn: On mobilisation Finland raised about 530,000 men in 1941 and roughly 630,000 to 700,000 at the 1944 peak, counting auxiliaries and reserves, while the population fell from about 4.4 million in 1941 to about 3.8 million in 1944. On the Karelian Isthmus in June 1941 the Finns committed some 250,000 men, four divisions and five brigades against a Soviet first line of about fifteen divisions and a second line of about ten; in September 1944 the Soviets massed more than a thousand guns and some thousand aircraft in the Vyborg-Petrozavodsk sector. For losses, Finnish official and post-war counting usually gives a total of 53,000 to 63,000 dead for the Continuation War and the Lapland War together, with about 2,000 taken prisoner, the prisoners not coming home until 1955. Soviet dead are given officially as around 160,000 to 170,000 and assessed by Finnish and Western studies at 80,000 to 130,000, and the Finnish war graves commission has put the two sides' dead in the defence of the VT Line at about 50,000 and 140,000. In distance, the 1941 axis from east of Vyborg to the Svir ran some three hundred kilometres, and Vyborg lay only a few tens of kilometres inside the 1940 Soviet frontier. Territory was the heaviest cost: Petsamo, Salla, southern Kuusamo and the islands of the Gulf of Finland, about one to one and a fifth of the country, with 400,000 to 460,000 Karelian evacuees; the Frontier Railway ran about eighty kilometres in 1941 and some three hundred by 1944; the 1947 Paris Peace Treaty set reparations at 300 million US dollars, leased the Petsamo nickel mines to the Soviet Union for fifteen years and kept Porkkala as a Soviet naval base until 1956.
cause: 打落嚟有幾層原因。最直接係冬季戰爭留下嘅傷痕：1940年芬蘭把卡累利阿地峽、佩特索莫、薩拉等約一成二領土割讓畀蘇聯，維堡省嘅造紙、鋸木同紡織工業連同佩特索莫嘅鎳礦與北極航道全部失去，芬蘭社會一直視為屈辱，視為一筆待補嘅債。加上蘇聯境內東卡累利阿仍有大量卡累利阿同族，芬蘭方面嘅民族國家理想要求收復被劃走嘅同族土地。蘇聯嗰邊則要求芬蘭放棄武裝中立、限制奧蘭群島非軍化、處理漢科租借地同波羅的海嘅戰略地位，1940至41年嘅莫斯科談判一直喺呢啲條款上拉鋸。國際層面，1939年德蘇互不侵犯條約把芬蘭放喺中立國位置，1941年6月22日德軍進攻蘇聯之後，芬蘭無法再保持中立，德方要求芬蘭參戰，並以東卡累利阿、佩特索莫與北極港口作為1939年德方扣押芬蘭商船嘅賠償；芬軍指揮層則計算，冬季戰爭已證明蘇聯步兵可以被擊敗，而德軍會把蘇聯主力吸喺別處。於是6月25日芬蘭對蘇聯宣戰，繼續戰爭正係冬季戰爭嘅翻版同擴大。
causeEn: Several layers of cause lie behind the fighting. The most immediate is the wound left by the Winter War: in 1940 Finland had ceded about one fifth of its territory, including the Karelian Isthmus, Petsamo and Salla, and had lost the province of Vyborg with its pulp, sawmill and textile industry, the nickel of Petsamo and access to the Arctic route. Finnish society treated that settlement as a humiliation and as a debt to be repaid, and the presence of large Karelian populations across the new Soviet frontier gave the idea of a greater national state a concrete homeland to recover. The Soviet side pressed for Finnish disarmament, for the demilitarisation of the Åland islands, for the Hanko lease and for a weaker Finnish position in the Baltic, and the Moscow talks of 1940-41 ran on precisely these clauses. At the international level the German-Soviet Pact of 1939 had assigned Finland the position of a neutral state, and once Germany attacked on 22 June 1941 Finland could no longer stay neutral; Berlin demanded that Finland join in and offered East Karelia, Petsamo and Arctic ports as compensation for the Finnish merchant fleet seized in 1939. The Finnish command, for its part, calculated that the Winter War had already shown Soviet infantry could be beaten, and that Germany would absorb the main weight of the Soviet army elsewhere. Finland declared war on 25 June, and the Continuation War was at once the replay and the enlargement of the Winter War.
impact: 戰敗重塑咗芬蘭嘅國家性格。1947年巴黎和約確認割讓佩特索莫、薩拉同維堡灣島嶼，芬蘭永久失去自己嘅北極深水港同鎳礦資源，維堡省嘅造紙、鋸木、紡織與機械廠連同四萬六千名居民一齊歸零；約四十萬卡累利阿人流亡到中南部，埋下一條同同族分離有關嘅傷痕。對外，芬蘭由北歐小國變成必須同莫斯科周旋嘅衛星國：波卡拉租作蘇聯海軍基地到1956年，1955年歸還，1956年簽芬蘇友好條約，承認1940年邊界，奠下往後數十年芬蘭化的外交傳統，直到2022年芬蘭申請加入北約仍然靠呢套語言運作。內政上更掀起憲政危機：一批軍官策劃喺盟軍登陸後推翻政府、讓曼納海姆做總統，蘇聯情報機關主動策動，1945至48年多次政治審訊，1953年軍事法庭仍判咗一批人；曼納海姆1946年辭職之後，軍人團體從此被懷疑係芬蘭永不作戰路線嘅幕後力量。芬蘭亦用行動同德國切割：1944年10月至1945年4月嘅拉普蘭戰爭係芬蘭單方面驅逐北諾爾境內德軍，雙方死傷數以萬計，成為北歐外交罕見嘅前盟友反目案例。
impactEn: Defeat reshaped the Finnish national character. The Paris Peace Treaty of 1947 confirmed the loss of Petsamo, Salla and the islands of the Gulf of Finland; Finland permanently surrendered its own Arctic deep-water harbour and its nickel resources, and the pulp, sawmill, textile and engineering works of the province of Vyborg went with roughly 46,000 inhabitants, while some 400,000 Karelians were resettled in the south and centre of the country, leaving a lasting sense of a people divided from its kin. In foreign affairs Finland became a small state obliged to manage its relations with Moscow: Porkkala was leased as a Soviet naval base until it was handed back in 1955, the 1956 treaty with the Soviet Union recognised the 1940 frontier, and the doctrine of accommodation with Moscow was fixed for decades, and was still the working language when Finland applied to join NATO in 2022. At home the war raised a constitutional crisis: a group of officers planned to bring down the government once the Allies landed and hand the presidency to Mannerheim, with Soviet intelligence actively encouraging them; political trials followed in 1945-48 and a court martial in 1953, and after Mannerheim resigned in 1946 the officer corps was permanently suspected of standing behind the policy of never fighting again. Finland also broke with Germany in practice: the Lapland War of October 1944 to April 1945 drove German forces out of northern Norway and Finnish Lapland at a cost of thousands of dead on both sides, a rare case in northern diplomacy of a former ally turning its guns on its friend.
result: 1944年9月19日芬蘭代表喺莫斯科同蘇聯簽訂停戰協議：恢復1940年邊界，割讓佩特索莫、薩拉、科薩莫南部同維堡灣諸島，承諾驅逐境內德軍並喺1945年4月前交還佩特索莫。1944年10月3日國會以壓倒性多數通過協議，而曼納海姆同年8月已出任總統。芬軍自地峽節節退到舊界，1944年10月德軍撤出北諾爾觸發拉普蘭戰爭，芬軍用數月時間掃清北方，1945年4月25日德軍最後離開，芬軍隨即重入佩特索莫。戰俘約二千餘人直到1955年先返國，戰時配給制亦延續到1947年。1947年2月10日巴黎和約把呢啲條款正式化，並加上三億美元賠償、佩特索莫鎳礦租約與波卡拉租借；芬蘭隨即大規模復員改組軍隊，國防軍於1946年完成新編制，戰時經濟管制逐步廢除。戰役以芬蘭嘅戰術勝利同戰略失敗收場：地峽突擊、塔利—伊漢塔拉、斯維里與伊洛曼察都係芬軍嘅輝煌時刻，但最終無法抵銷1944年蘇聯以火炮同絕對兵力換來嘅整條戰線反攻。
resultEn: On 19 September 1944 Finnish representatives signed the armistice in Moscow: the 1940 frontier was restored, Petsamo, Salla, southern Kuusamo and the islands of the Gulf of Finland were ceded, and Finland undertook to drive German troops from its territory and to hand Petsamo back by April 1945. The Eduskunta approved the terms on 3 October 1944 by an overwhelming majority, and Mannerheim had been made president in August. The Finnish army withdrew step by step to the old frontier, and the German withdrawal from northern Norway in October 1944 triggered the Lapland War, which took the Finns months of fighting to clear the north; the last German troops left on 25 April 1945 and the Finns reoccupied Petsamo. About 2,000 prisoners of war did not come home until 1955, and rationing continued into 1947. The Paris Peace Treaty of 10 February 1947 made those terms formal and added 300 million dollars of reparations, the Petsamo nickel lease and the Porkkala tenancy. The army was demobilised and rebuilt, a new national defence force was established in 1946, and the wartime economic controls were dismantled. The campaign ended with Finnish tactical brilliance and strategic defeat: the break-in on the Isthmus, Tali-Ihantala, the Svir and Ilomantsi are celebrated Finnish successes, but none of them could offset the Soviet counter-offensive of 1944, bought with massed artillery and absolute superiority in numbers.
